Collecting Belenon

Showcase Treatments

Gig posters, classic records and a map of the whole plane: every special version of the cards in Belenon: Battle of the Bands.

  • Concert Posters
  • Vinyl Classics
  • Full-art basics
  • Where to find them

Every great show sells merch. Belenon's headliners get their names on gig posters, the plane's record shops are restocking the classics, and someone finally drew a map of where all ten guilds live. Here's every showcase treatment in Belenon: Battle of the Bands, and where to find each one.

Concert Posters

Every one of the set's 32 real-world legends gets a Concert Poster version: the legend billed like a headliner on a gig poster from their genre and its era. A Romantic-era pianist gets an engraved concert playbill. A punk singer gets a photocopied flyer with ransom-note lettering. A bebop vocalist gets a modernist jazz record sleeve look in flat color blocks.

The posters don't stop at the edge of the paper. Each one hangs where you'd find that genre's posters in the wild, and the setting is the card's border:

  • Classical: behind glass in an opera house's gilded display case
  • Rap: wheat-pasted to a brick wall over scraps of older posters
  • Metal: duct-taped to a black club door covered in stickers
  • Rock 'n' Roll: thumbtacked to '70s wood paneling in a teenager's bedroom
  • Country: nailed to weathered red barn boards
  • Soul: taped inside a record shop window
  • Jazz: in a club's marquee case, ringed with bulbs
  • Electronic: soggy and crooked in a rain gutter
  • Punk: stapled to a telephone pole thick with old staples
  • Blues: nailed to a juke joint's rusty tin wall

Every legend in Belenon is a Saga creature that transforms into one of their greatest songs, so every poster has a back. Turn one over and you'll find that song's chapters printed as the night's concert program or setlist.

The rivals get posters too: Amadeus and Salieri, both billed in the Classical style.

Vinyl Classics

Vinyl Classics are 20 Magic favorites reprinted in Belenon, two for each guild and one in each of its colors. Each one comes as a record from the guild's crate: a famous album cover from that guild's genre, redrawn as a parody on Belenon with the guild's people showing what the card does. The Dark Side of the Moon becomes The Dark Side of the Winds on Fireball. The Beatles' crossing becomes Roarbowl Road on Overrun. Kendrick Lamar's To Pimp a Butterfly becomes To Pimp a Cypher on Hero's Downfall.

Every album comes from an artist who isn't already a card in the set, so the record shop widens each genre beyond the stage. The cover sits on a listening-room shelf in the guild's colors, above a record player and a console that hold the card's type line and rules text, with "Vinyl Classics" stamped in gold leaf down the spine.

Full-art basics: the map

Each guild gets a full-art version of both its basic land types, for 20 full-art basics in all, four of each type. On their own, they're painted views of each guild's home turf from high above: the Kilnpits volcano, the Twangwood's humming oaks, the Cypher Stacks rising from the canal flats.

Put all 20 together and they're one painting. Lay them out five across and four down and you get a map of the whole plane of Belenon, from the wreck-strewn peaks in the north to the delta mouth in the south, with the Sacred Wind blowing west to east across every card and out to sea past Bellmouth. Cadenza's two lands meet at the center, where the Windriddle Palaces wait for the Gale.

Each land keeps the color of the mana it makes, so the Plains glow gold, the Islands run blue, the Swamps sink into black bog, the Mountains burn red and the Forests stay deep green. Each guild's symbol sits at the top of its two lands, and each guild's venue sits on its land as a small landmark.

Where to find them

Draft and Sealed don't change. The Play Booster has no showcase treatments at all: 14 cards with 8 commons, a Technique, 3 uncommons, a rare or mythic rare and one double-faced card. Every showcase card in this article is found only in Collector Boosters:

  • Concert Posters: all 32 legends
  • Vinyl Classics: 20 reprints, at special rarity
  • Full-art basics: 20 lands, one map

Want to see them all? The card gallery has them in its Art menu, including a view that lays the full-art basics out as the map.

Set details

  • Set name: Belenon: Battle of the Bands
  • Set code: BBB
  • Main set: 290 cards (100 commons, 105 uncommons, 65 rares, 20 mythic rares)
  • Collector Booster extras: 32 Concert Posters, 20 Vinyl Classics, 20 full-art basics
